title: Ozarks Skydive Center

services.name: Learn To Skydive
services.desc: Made a tandem jump and caught the skydiving bug? We get it - we were in your shoes once! Take your passion to the next level by earning your solo skydiving license with the experienced instructors of Ozarks Skydive Center! Our commitment to the highest levels of safety, customer satisfaction, and personalized guidance extends to our teaching philosophy. We follow skydiving best practices as defined by the United States Parachute Association (USPA) in order to produce licensed skydivers who are competent, confident, and ready to responsibly fly solo. Under the instruction of Ozarks Skydive Center, you will learn the skills and knowledge required to complete the A License Proficiency Card.

Since launching in 2012, Ozarks Skydive Center has steadily grown, mostly through word of mouth. We are not a traditional Missori skydiving center whereby we seek high volume. Instead, our approach is different.
